governanceNotes: D1 batch 39 (2026-09-23): deferred. Duplicate-scope class screen recorded 2026-09-23: (i) the catalog carries distinct identities for every form this general label spans - atrophic-glossitis (draft, carrying the anemia association edge), benign-migratory-glossitis (draft, carrying the psoriasis association edge), median-rhomboid-glossitis (developmental-form backlog identity), geographic-tongue (deferred batch 37 as the exact synonym of benign-migratory-glossitis), and oral-candidiasis (owning the infectious erythematous-glossitis presentations) - so any edge authored from glossitis would run a parallel pathway alongside the form-specific identity's edge for the same disease in the same patient (the batch-22 diabetes-mellitus, batch-27 eczema, batch-33 female-reproductive-disorders, and batch-37 gastrointestinal-cancers class bans); (ii) form-heterogeneity defeat - the general label mixes infectious (candidal, bacterial), atrophic (iron, vitamin B12, folate deficiency), migratory (benign migratory glossitis), developmental (median rhomboid), irritative (denture, tobacco, chemical), and secondary (sicca, candidal under xerostomia) etiologies with different mechanisms, different drivers, and different defensible targets, so no single causal mechanism or evidentiary profile could honestly represent a class edge (mechanism-representativeness guard); (iii) candidate-target screen - ageusia and xerostomia exist as catalog identities but the candidate glossitis-to-taste or glossitis-to-dryness links resolve within the form-specific and driver-specific pathways (xerostomia upstream of candidal glossitis; deficiency states upstream of atrophic glossitis) rather than through the general label, and burning-mouth-syndrome (with its own depressive edge) shows association literature pooled across glossitis forms without form-specific direction; (iv) the batch-38 gingivitis edge maps the gingival-site analog at association strength with a shared-driver guard, and no evidence distinguishes a general-glossitis pathway that the form identities cannot own. Reopening condition: a governance merge that canonizes one tongue-inflammation identity, after which the surviving identity's edges can be authored once without duplication, or a form-adjusted general-glossitis evidence base.
